what_worked: Slide titles hint at a B2B + AI thesis that loosely connects to dataset themes.
fix_next: Every chart is a broken placeholder (600×400 grey box); no actual data, analysis, or evidence is presented anywhere in the deck.
verdict: A marketing landing page with placeholder images, not a data-story presentation.
factual_error_detail: Slide 3: Claims B2B generates 'significantly higher and more stable recurring revenue' vs B2C—actual median multiples are nearly identical (2.35x vs 2.30x). Slide 4: Calls AI 'the absolute strongest revenue driver' without noting it has the most companies (197) and a low median ($503), overstating the finding.

evidence.insight: No quantitative finding is actually shown; slides 3-5 make vague claims ('B2B dominance', 'AI leads') with zero supporting numbers, charts, or analysis visible.
evidence.narrative: Slides follow a product-pitch arc (problem → solution → market → CTA) rather than a data-story arc; no synthesis or analytical landing.
evidence.framing: No dataset description, no scope/definitions, no mention of sample size, missingness, or limitations. A cold reader would not know what data underlies any claim.
evidence.accuracy: Cannot verify any chart because every chart area is a 600×400 placeholder. The two textual claims made (slides 3, 4) are misleading or unsupported.
evidence.visual: Every slide where a chart should appear shows only a grey '600 × 400' placeholder box. Slides 7 and 8 are identical duplicates. Template is a SaaS landing page, not a presentation.
evidence.ai_slop: Entire deck is an AI-generated SaaS marketing template with placeholder images never replaced, consulting buzzwords ('ARPU', 'zero-growth line'), and no actual content. Slides 7-8 are duplicated image-source pages.
